name: ant0
description: Ant0 is a browser for automation and agents. Pre-release. Needs the Ant0 desktop app running on this computer.
long_description:
Ant0 is a browser for automation and agents. Each profile has its own saved identity, proxy, cookies and storage. This server lets an agent pick or create a profile, run it, and work in its tabs.

Pre-release: built from Ant0 desktop 0.3.22-beta.2.

Requirement: the Ant0 desktop app must be installed and running on this computer (https://ant0.link). The server talks only to that local app and holds no account keys.
